player_facing_text: Rain spatters soot-dark stone; frayed banners hang above Cinderwatch's eastern gate. Refugees, wagons, and foot traffic clog the muddy approach; guards hold the choke while the crowd presses in. A tavern runner shouts offers of hot stew and paid rumor. You can read the notice board, press the guards, or approach the tavern runner.
stubbed_provider_narration: You leave the gate and arrive at the market quarter.
